    WELCOME TO THE LAB

    A mystery is better
    with company.

    The machine accepts some signals and rejects others. One of the six theories explains its hidden rule.

    1. 01
      Send an experiment.

      Choose a colour, shape, and pulse count. In Twitch chat, type !test blue circle 2.

    2. 02
      Follow the evidence.

      Compare what passes and fails. Theories that contradict a result are crossed out automatically.

    3. 03
      Agree on a theory.

      Vote with !solve a through !solve f. Each researcher gets one vote and can change it. The streamer locks the leading theory.

    Choose 3, 5, or 8 minutes before starting. 18 unique experiments. 2 incorrect locks. In practice, the controls generate labelled sample chat.
    BRING YOUR CHAT INTO THE LAB

    Connect Twitch.

    Sign in with the Twitch account that owns the channel. Signal Lab requests permission to read that channel’s chat.

    1. Enable 2FA on your Twitch account.
    2. Register an app in the Twitch Developer Console ↗. Choose a Public client type, if asked.
    3. Add this exact OAuth Redirect URL:
    4. Paste the app’s Client ID below. Then authorize Twitch.

    Use the Client ID, not the client secret. Sign-in stays in memory; refreshing requires reconnecting.
